titles.title: Quake1
titles.engine_and_build:
id Quake, Games-Library\Quake1 (re-hashed from /mnt 2026-09-29):
- GLQUAKE.EXE 435,712 B md5 bcf40493 (byte-identical to VOODOO\GLQUAKE.EXE).
- WINQUAKE.EXE 553,472 B md5 0b62b82d (SciTech MGL software build).
- QUAKE.EXE 409,600 B md5 e3e7fcc9 = the DOS build DOSGAME.TXT names (CWSDPMI.EXE beside it).
- VOODOO\OPENGL32.DLL 142,848 B md5 332ee07b = the Quake II 3.20 3dfx MiniGL (imports glide2x.dll!_grSstWinOpen@28).
- Version: the survey's '1.09' is not backed by a string (only 'Version %4.2f' formats); the tree's own ID1\autoexec.cfg says 1.08. Not load-bearing.
- .243 also has D:\GAMES\QUAKEPRP (DOS, software) per the survey's DIRLIST. No DOS Glide Quake exists, so the only Voodoo 2 path is Win98 GLQuake over the MiniGL.
titles.on_boxes:
Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240 .243 (confirmed from the survey's DIRLIST C:\Games JSON).
- .123 (HD 3850, Catalyst 8.970.100.0), .145 (8400GS, 6.14.13.4052 = ForceWare 340.52), .240 (HWPROFILE: Radeon X1600 on 8.593.100.0, not the X800 in the inventory) and .195 (Win7, HD 5450, 15.200): 'Play Quake.bat' = GLQUAKE.EXE on the vendor ICD; 'Play Quake - Software.bat' = WINQUAKE.EXE. The Voodoo shortcut is gated (no glide capability).
- .124: GLQUAKE.EXE on the system ICD retroicd.dll (MesaFX 0.1.76), over our h5 glide3x.dll (md5 38a891e8), on vcr-kmd. The Voodoo shortcut finds VEN_121A&DEV_0009 via reg.exe and CALLs Play Quake.bat.
- .243: 'Play Quake - Voodoo.bat' = VOODOO\GLQUAKE.EXE + MiniGL over C:\WINDOWS\SYSTEM\GLIDE2X.DLL (226,304 B; the share copy of the same 3.02.02 kit has FileVersion 2.56.00.0459) on the pass-through Voodoo 2. 'Play Quake - Software.bat' = WinQuake on the Cirrus 5436. The GL shortcut is gated. DOS QUAKE.EXE runs from DOSGAME.
titles.resolution_per_box:
Play Quake.bat calls FLEETRES -cap 1280 960, then runs GLQUAKE.EXE -width %FR_W43% -height %FR_H43% -bpp 32.
- 16:9 LCDs (.123 .145 .240 .195): 800x600, COMPUTED.
  - The shipped FLEETRES.EXE (md5 bb180f3b in all 43 staged copies; the repo build of fleetres.c at 26dbe12) takes the LCD branch on all four. The fleetres.cmd each box wrote at 04:58-05:02 UTC (DOWNLOADed read-only 01:09 EDT) read FR_EDID=1, FR_PANEL=LCD and, uncapped, FR_W43=1280x960.
  - With -cap 1280 960, the cap branch keeps 16:9 and picks 1280x720, which all four list. The 4:3 ladder inside 720 lines then stops at 800x600.
  - The '1280x960' in the launcher comment and PER-TITLE-STATUS.md was most likely measured with explicit -width/-height.
- .124: 1280x960x32 (CRT branch; retrogl.log GetClientRect=1280x960 for GLQUAKE.EXE).
- .243: the Voodoo launcher is fixed at 640x480x16; the MiniGL maps height <= 480 (cmp 0x1e0) to GR_RESOLUTION_640x480. WinQuake picks its own mode. DOS Quake defaults to 320x200 VGA.
titles.refresh_control:
None in the engine. Confirmed with strings -a and a case-insensitive grep: only r_norefresh, timerefresh, vid_mode, _vid_default_mode(_win) and _vid_wait_override; switches -width/-height/-bpp/-current/-mode/-window/-force.
- GLQUAKE.EXE VID_SetFullDIBMode: 0x41448c dmFields=0x1c0000 (no DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY), 0x414485 push 4 (CDS_FULLSCREEN), 0x4144d0 call ChangeDisplaySettingsA.
- Missed by the survey: 0x414470-0x414480 skips that call entirely when leavecurrentmode ([0x8094a0], set by -current) is on. -current keeps the desktop's mode and rate with no mode change, but gains nothing here: the LCD desktops are 1920x1080@60, and .124's desktop is 5:4 with Glide re-setting the mode anyway.
- VID_InitFullDIB: bpp >= 15, w/h <= 10000 (0x2710), list capped at 30 (cmp eax,0x1e at 0x415881), CDS_TEST|CDS_FULLSCREEN. The 30-slot list, not a compiled 4:3 table, refuses large modes, and -force cannot add a mode once the list is full.
- Voodoo path: the MiniGL passes ref 0 = GR_REFRESH_60Hz at 0x100034c5, 0x1000b9f6 and 0x1000ba81. Glide 2.56 replaces it only through SSTV2_SCREENREFRESH or SSTV2_REFRESH_<WxH>. It accepts 75, 85 or 120; anything else becomes 60 (cvg video.c sst1InitConvertRefreshRate). Lookup order: env, then HKLM Software\3Dfx Interactive\Voodoo2\Glide, then ...\Voodoo2. SST_SCREENREFRESH is absent from the DLL (case-insensitive check).
- .124: the ICD's fxBestRefresh uses env FX_GLIDE_REFRESH_RATE / SSTV2_REFRESH_RATE / MESA_FX_REFRESH, otherwise the driver's highest listed rate at WxH (no EDID cap). h5 hwcInitVideo then overrides it with FX_GLIDE_REFRESH via hwcGetenv: getenv, then HKCU\<path>, then HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide. getRegPath hardcodes 3dfxvs\Device0 on 2k/XP whenever that key exists, and it does on .124.
- WinQuake and DOS Quake: no control.
titles.set_today:
Nothing sets a refresh (confirmed).
- Launchers: Play Quake.bat passes -width/-height/-bpp only. The Voodoo launcher passes 640x480x16 and no SSTV2_*.
- There is no GAMERES rule; ID1\autoexec.cfg sets no video cvar. FR_HZ=60 on the four LCDs, and this launcher does not use it.
- gameres_raise_refresh is a no-op everywhere: the LCDs are at 1920x1080@60 (the best there), .124 at 1280x1024@85, and .243 has no EDID, so it refuses.
- In force on .124: HKLM\...\3dfxvs\Device0\glide FX_GLIDE_REFRESH='75', left by the vendor panel. Nothing in HKCU or the environment. HKLM\Software\RetroAgent GlideRender=1 (read 01:09), so FR_UE1DEV=GlideDrv there.
- In force on .243: Voodoo2\Glide holds only SSTV2_R/G/BGAMMA=1.30; the Win98 display RefreshRate is '75'.
- Missed by the survey: .123 and .240 carry ATI's 3D_Refresh_Rate_Override_DEF=0 (no override) in their driver keys.
titles.best_per_box:
gr_best_hz from the EDID-capped GAMERES lists (re-read 01:08-01:09, unchanged):
- .123, .145, .240: 800x600@75 (1280x960 is also 75).
- .195: 800x600@60.
- .124: 1280x960@85 (vcr-kmd list; EDID vmax 160).
- .243: no claim is possible. There is no EDID, the Cirrus lists 640x480@0, and a pass-through Voodoo 2 appears in no driver list. The persisted 1024x768@75 measures only that mode; gameres.h's gr_best_hz at 640x480 is 0 there. The roster prose names the tube 'DELL E773c': a recorded model, not a measurement.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
- .123, .145, .240: most likely 60, unmeasured on these drivers. The CDS carries no frequency. XP gave 60 on ForceWare 71.89 (.124, 2026-08-25), even at the desktop's own 1024x768@100. ATI's own 3D override is 0 on .123 and .240.
- .195: 60, the only rate offered.
- .124: most likely 75. retrogl.log shows fxBestRefresh 1280x960 max 85 -> ref enum 7 -> grSstWinOpenExt ref=7, and Glide then substitutes the registry's 75.
  - That substitution was measured on .124: glidelab's opened_hz read-back on 2026-09-26 recorded a 60 Hz request opening at 75 (tests/python/test_vcr_kmd_monitor_safety.py).
  - vcr-kmd's timing table has 1280x960@75 (common/vcr_modes.c:88). If its EDID-filtered list lacked it, Glide would fall back to refresh 0 (win_mode.c).
  - The in-game rate is unmeasured.
- .243 Voodoo: 60 (ref 0, no override), unmeasured.
- .243 WinQuake: probably 75 from the Win98 adapter setting, unmeasured.
- DOS Quake: BIOS timing (mode 13h = 70 Hz).
titles.gap:
- .123, .145, .240: likely 60 against 75 available (-15 Hz).
- .195: none.
- .124: 75 against 85 (-10 Hz), caused by a stale 3dfx registry value, not the game.
- .243: the Voodoo is at 60, with no provable ceiling.
- Side finding for the resolution workflow: FR_W43 on the 16:9 boxes is 800x600, not 1280x960.
titles.fix:
1. XP ATI/NVIDIA boxes (.123 .145 .240): the engine has nothing to set, so re-apply the game's own mode with a frequency using agent/tools/refreshkeep.c. It held Quake II and UT at 100 Hz on .143 under ForceWare 71.89.
   - FLEETRES.EXE must publish FR_HZ43 and FR_HZW: the best rate at the post-cap FR_W43xFR_H43 and FR_WxFR_H, i.e. the per-mode maximum over bpp >= 16, EDID vmax cap applied at insert, 50-199 band, 0 without EDID. Mirror-test it against gameres.h.
   - FLEETRES records no rates today (add_mode(w,h) only), so this is new code in a 30 KB exe staged in 43 trees.
   - stage-fleetres.py must clear both variables in FLEETRES.BAT and default them to 0, not to 60 as it does for FR_HZ.
   - Use them only on command lines, never in a cfg both writers touch, so the NOTE ON REFRESH fight cannot start.
   - Stage REFRESHKEEP.EXE and start it hidden, as scripts/game-refresh/deploy_game_refresh.py already does (wscript //nologo hidden.vbs "..."), not with 'start /min'. A console window that takes activation makes GLQuake's AppActivate restore the desktop and suspend.
   - Gate: if /i not "%FR_UE1DEV%"=="GlideDrv.GlideRenderDevice" if %FR_HZ43% GTR 60 <hidden> REFRESHKEEP.EXE %FR_HZ43% GLQUAKE.EXE 14400. This excludes .124 today (GlideRender=1).
   - Alternative on .123 and .240 only: ATI's 3D_Refresh_Rate_Override_DEF. It is a per-box vendor-driver setting, not a 3dfx one. ATI's panels presented it as a Direct3D override, so its reach into a CDS-based OpenGL title is unknown; measure it first.
2. .124: in the launcher, set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=%FR_HZ43% (85). Gate it on FR_UE1DEV==GlideDrv, not on FR_GLIDE, which is also 1 on .143 where the V5 is a secondary adapter. An env var is not a driver change.
   - The registry route (clear the value, or 3dfxctl.exe 'Fullscreen refresh rate: Auto', which removes exactly that value) is a 3dfx-driver setting shared with the V5 benchmark lane. Use it only on an explicit chat request, and never with REGDELETE, which erases the whole glide key.
   - Never run refreshkeep on .124.
3. .243: no automatic rate. The survey's 'largest of 75/85/120 not above the persisted desktop rate' exceeds the no-EDID rule: gr_best_hz is 0 at 640x480, and gr_raise_desktop_refresh refuses without EDID.
   - This needs an operator-recorded ceiling, e.g. a per-box DWORD under HKLM\Software\RetroAgent following the ResCapW/ResCapH pattern, set after checking the tube.
   - Then one writer emits an unquoted COMMAND.COM fragment (set SSTV2_REFRESH_640x480=75|85|120) that 'Play Quake - Voodoo.bat' CALLs when present. Without it, 60 stays.
   - The Voodoo2\Glide registry equivalent is a 3dfx-driver setting and needs the operator.
4. .195: nothing to do.
5. No Quake, Quake II or Hexen II source port is on the share (case-insensitive find, depth 5).
titles.fix_risk:
- refreshkeep causes a second mode switch about 1 s after each of the game's own; the LCD blanks briefly.
- It is unmeasured whether Catalyst 8.970/8.593 and ForceWare 340.52 keep a fullscreen GL context through an external CDS. Only ForceWare 71.89 was tested.
- refreshkeep applies with flags 0, so a crash can strand the desktop at 800x600@75.
- refreshkeep honours a rate only if it is listed at the live WxHxbpp; otherwise it silently does nothing (safe).
- gr_best_hz checks only EDID vmax, not the EDID horizontal or pixel-clock limits. Check the OSD at 75 on .123/.145 (analog) and .240 (DVI).
- On .243, a wrong rate means 'out of range' on an unwatched CRT, on a box whose recovery needs a person. COMMAND.COM upper-cases env names; Glide's MSVC getenv and its registry fallback match case-insensitively, but verify it. 'Out of environment space' would drop the set silently.
titles.verify_on_hw:
Test one box at a time, paced, fullscreen, at the menu.
- XP and Win7: DISPLAYCFG get (ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS) plus the OSD. The same read settles 800x600 against 1280x960.
- Before any launch, a read-only EXEC of FLEETRES.EXE -info -cap 1280 960 in the tree confirms FR_W43.
- .124, together with the V5 lane: DISPLAYCFG get during play (glidelab's opened_hz uses the same call), C:\retrogl.log 'fxBestRefresh', and the vcrctl log 'mode N: WxHxBPP@HZ'.
- .243: run once with SSTV2_INITDEBUG_FILE=C:\V2INIT.TXT, which enables logging on its own (print.c). DOWNLOAD the file (never read it through EXEC) and read 'sst1InitVideo() Setting up video for resolution (640, 480), Refresh:NN Hz'. Also check the OSD.
titles.verifier_notes:
Confirmed:
- md5s and sizes.
- No refresh cvar or switch (case-insensitive strings).
- Every quoted GLQUAKE address, including the 30-mode cap and the 10000 w/h limits.
- MiniGL ref 0 at all three sites.
- Glide 2.56: the SSTV2 names, the 75/85/120 rule, the lookup order, no SST_SCREENREFRESH, FileVersion 2.56.00.0459.
- h5 getRegPath/hwcGetenv/FX_GLIDE_REFRESH (source and deployed strings); fxBestRefresh is not EDID-capped.
- on_boxes, and the best rates (GAMERES re-read).
- FR_W43=800x600 on 16:9: code plus real FLEETRES outputs showing the LCD branch.
Corrected:
- The .243 automatic 75 violates the no-EDID rule.
- The survey's 'start /min' refreshkeep should be the hidden.vbs launch.
- FR_GLIDE is the wrong gate for FX_GLIDE_REFRESH.
- Missed: -current, ATI's 3D_Refresh_Rate_Override_DEF, the measured glidelab evidence for .124's 75, and 1280x960@75 in vcr-kmd's table.
Evidence: .claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-review/ (strings-refresh-ci.txt, glquake-cds-and-modelist.txt, boxes/*-frcmd.json.*, boxes/124.json). The ATI keys are in .claude/evidence-refresh/mechanism/boxes/123__REGREAD_ATI_video_0000.txt and 240__REGREAD_...550187F2...0000.txt.

titles.title: Quake2Complete
titles.engine_and_build:
id Quake II 3.20 (confirmed):
- quake2.exe 362,496 B md5 57dd2cf4.
- ref_gl.dll 234,496 B md5 b6d33427.
- ref_soft.dll md5 203dc879.
- 3dfxgl.dll md5 332ee07b (the same file as Quake1's VOODOO\OPENGL32.DLL).
- pvrgl.dll 227,328 B.
- Mod directories: xatrix, rogue, ctf.
titles.on_boxes:
.123 .124 .145 .195 .240 (confirmed).
- Not on .243: requires.json min_os win2k, and the compat DB records 'not enough free disk (have 604 MB, needs 840)'. .243 gets Quake2Win9x.
- gl_driver is opengl32 (the system ICD): ATI on .123/.240, NVIDIA 340.52 on .145 (GL path untested there), AMD on Win7 .195.
- On .124, retroicd.dll loads the game-local glide3x.dll (same md5 as system32's).
- Four launchers: Quake II, The Reckoning, Ground Zero, ThreeWave CTF.
titles.resolution_per_box:
gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE% = 8 = 1280x960 on all five. Sources: GAMERES q2mode 8, and FR_Q2MODE=8 in the four LCD boxes' fleetres.cmd. On .124 it is confirmed by baseq2\fleetres.cfg and retrogl.log.

New: Quake II sets the mode TWICE per launch.
- The first mode set happens before autoexec.cfg. .243's qconsole.log shows 'Loading ref_gl.dll ... setting mode 3' before 'execing autoexec.cfg'.
- baseq2\autoexec.cfg then sets gl_mode "6" and exec's fleetres.cfg ("8"). That flags gl_mode modified, which triggers a vid_restart.
- .124's retrogl.log shows two GL contexts per quake2.exe pid (1004, 1012, 116, 348, 1192, 628, 2044).
titles.refresh_control:
None (confirmed).
- ref_gl and quake2.exe strings, case-insensitive: gl_mode, gl_bitdepth, gl_driver, gl_swapinterval, gl_ext_swapinterval, vid_fullscreen, r_norefresh, timerefresh, vid_ref, and SST_GAMMA/SSTV2_GAMMA putenv (gamma only).
- ref_gl GLimp_SetMode: 0x1000de5e dmSize 0x9c; 0x1000de73 dmFields 0x180000; 0x1000de9a 0x1c0000; 0x1000def7 loads CDSA into ebx; 0x1000df04 push 4; 0x1000df07 call ebx.
- The retries at 0x1000e0a1/0x1000e1bb also pass no frequency.
- The 3dfxgl MiniGL uses ref 0.
- On .124, the ICD and Glide decide the rate as for Quake1.
titles.set_today:
fleetres.cfg in baseq2/xatrix/rogue/ctf, written by the launcher and by the GAMERES 'idtech2' body, holds only gl_mode and vid_fullscreen. There is no refresh line, and none is possible.
- FRHZ is unused here.
- .124's FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 applies.
- .124's archived baseq2\config.cfg has gl_swapinterval "0".
- .123 and .240 have ATI 3D_Refresh_Rate_Override_DEF=0.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
- .123, .145, .240: most likely 60 on both mode sets. XP was measured on ForceWare 71.89 only; unmeasured on these drivers.
- .195: 60.
- .124: most likely 75. The ICD asks for 85 (retrogl.log ref enum 7); the Glide registry override was measured on .124 (glidelab opened_hz); 1280x960@75 is in vcr-kmd's table. The in-game rate is unmeasured.
- Precedent on .143 (ForceWare 71.89): 60.0 fps vsync-capped at 60 Hz, 100.0 fps under refreshkeep 100.
titles.fix:
Use the generic mechanism, as for Quake1: a hidden REFRESHKEEP.EXE on quake2.exe at %FR_HZ43% in all four launchers, gated on FR_UE1DEV != GlideDrv and FR_HZ43 > 60.
- gl_mode indexes the 4:3 target, and every ladder mode is in the id Tech 2 table, so FR_HZ43 is the rate at the mode the game sets.
- refreshkeep will re-apply after both of the game's mode sets.

.124: set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=%FR_HZ43% in the launcher (the registry route needs explicit chat approval).

Do not put a refresh line in the idtech2 fleetres.cfg body:
- Quake II has no cvar to read it.
- That body is shared with SiNGold and SoldierOfFortune and their launchers' echo lines.

Per-title alternative: rebuild ref_gl.dll from id's GPL 3.21 source with a refresh cvar (API_VERSION 3 is unchanged, so quake2.exe 3.20 and :27910 are unaffected). Pass that cvar with +set on the command line, like gl_mode. It is new code for every GPU family and for .124's Glide ICD.

No Quake II port (Q2PRO, R1Q2, Yamagi, KMQuake2) is on the share (case-insensitive).
titles.fix_risk:
- The same risks as Quake1, across four launchers.
- There are two forced re-applies per launch, because the game already sets the mode twice.
- A rebuilt ref_gl is new code in every Quake II launch (the vid_restart and 3dfx gamma putenv paths).
- Quake II vsyncs by default, so a higher refresh also raises its frame cap. That changes benchmark baselines, although .124's config has gl_swapinterval 0.
titles.verify_on_hw:
- At the menu: DISPLAYCFG get and the monitor OSD.
- +set logfile 2 records '...setting mode 8: 1280 960 FS'. That confirms the resolution only; Quake II never logs the refresh.
- .124, with the V5 lane: retrogl.log, the vcrctl log, and DISPLAYCFG get during play.
titles.verifier_notes:
Confirmed: every string and address claim; no refresh cvar in 3.20; best rates; on_boxes.

Also confirmed: the survey's point that CLAUDE.md and gameres.h's NOTE ON REFRESH ('such engines take whatever the desktop is on') is contradicted by the 2026-08-25 .124 measurement (60 Hz at the desktop's own mode). Raising the persisted desktop rate does not reach a CDS-without-frequency game on XP. That comment should be corrected; it is moot today only because every desktop is already at its best rate.

Added: the two-mode-set behaviour; the hidden launch; the gate on FR_UE1DEV; the ATI override key; a warning against touching the shared idtech2 body.

Side note: the mirror test test_a_shared_cfg_is_written_identically_by_both_writers maps %HZ% to %FR_HZ%, two different quantities. It would pass a real mismatch if a body ever used %HZ%. If FR_HZ43 is added, map %HZ43% to %FR_HZ43% explicitly.

Evidence: .claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-review/strings-refresh-ci.txt; the survey's quake2-ref_gl-cds.txt; retrogl.log context counts.

titles.title: Quake2Win9x
titles.engine_and_build:
Quake II 3.20 base game for Win9x (confirmed):
- quake2.exe, ref_gl.dll, ref_soft.dll and 3dfxgl.dll are byte-identical to Quake2Complete's (md5 57dd2cf4, b6d33427, 203dc879, 332ee07b).
- The launchers use COMMAND.COM syntax.
- DESKFIX9.EXE is included.
titles.on_boxes:
Only on .243 (requires.json max_os win9x; confirmed by DIRLIST).
- 'Play Quake II - Voodoo.bat' echoes baseq2\fleetres.cfg (vid_ref gl, gl_driver 3dfxgl, gl_mode 3, vid_fullscreen 1), which runs the MiniGL over GLIDE2X.DLL 2.56.00.0459 on the pass-through Voodoo 2. The deployed qconsole.log shows 'setting mode 3: 640 480 FS' and GL_RENDERER '3Dfx Interactive Voodoo(tm)'.
- 'Play Quake II.bat' runs ref_soft through DirectDraw on the Cirrus 5436 (log: 'setting exclusive mode: ok').
titles.resolution_per_box:
.243 only.
- Voodoo: 640x480x16 (gl_mode 3, a launcher constant; COMMAND.COM cannot run FLEETRES.BAT).
- Software: 640x480 (sw_mode 3).
- The first renderer load happens before autoexec.cfg (qconsole.log line 3 against line 31). fleetres.cfg therefore takes effect on the next renderer load or restart.
titles.refresh_control:
- Game: none (as for Quake2Complete).
- Voodoo: the MiniGL calls grSstWinOpen with ref 0 (60 Hz). Glide 2.56 replaces that only with SSTV2_REFRESH_640x480 or SSTV2_SCREENREFRESH, accepting 75/85/120 (anything else becomes 60). It looks in the env first, then HKLM\Software\3Dfx Interactive\Voodoo2\Glide, then ...\Voodoo2.
- The Win32 GLIDE2X.DLL has no VOODOO2_FILE/VOODOO2_PATH strings; they appear only in GLIDE2X.OVL, so voodoo2.ini is DOS-only (confirmed).
- The kit's control panel 3DFXV2PS.DLL carries 'Override Monitor Refresh' and the SSTV2_REFRESH_<WxH> names (UTF-16), which supports the survey's registry alternative.
- Software path: Win98 applies the adapter's single RefreshRate setting.
titles.set_today:
Nothing (confirmed).
- The launchers write only renderer and mode lines.
- No SSTV2_* anywhere.
- There is no GAMERES rule for this title.
- Voodoo2\Glide holds gamma 1.30 only.
- Win98 RefreshRate is '75' (Class\Display\0000\DEFAULT and Config\0001\Display\Settings).
titles.best_per_box:
.243: no claim is possible. GAMERES reads edid:false and the modes 640x480@0, 800x600@0 and 1024x768@75.
- The Voodoo 2 has 640x480 timings at 60, 75, 85 and 120, but no measurement says the tube syncs any of them.
- The persisted 1024x768@75 proves only that mode.
- The roster calls the tube a DELL E773c. Its datasheet range is unchecked here and must be confirmed by the operator.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
- .243 Voodoo: 60 Hz. The code path is ref 0 with no override; unmeasured on screen.
- .243 software: probably 75, from the Win98 adapter RefreshRate, if the Cirrus offers it at 640x480. Unmeasured; DISPLAYCFG reads the live refresh as 0 on this box.
titles.gap: The Voodoo runs at 60 Hz. The tube's true ceiling is unmeasured and unrecorded.
titles.fix:
Corrected: do not derive the rate automatically from the persisted desktop rate. That exceeds the no-EDID rule (gr_best_hz 0 at 640x480; GAMERES refuses any refresh without EDID).
1. The operator records a ceiling for this tube, e.g. a per-box DWORD in HKLM\Software\RetroAgent following the ResCapW/ResCapH pattern.
2. Exactly ONE writer (the agent's GAMERES pass, which runs on 9x) turns it into an unquoted COMMAND.COM fragment beside the launcher, e.g. VOODOO2HZ.BAT containing 'set SSTV2_REFRESH_640x480=75' and 'set SSTV2_REFRESH_800x600=75'. Only 75, 85 or 120 are valid.
3. 'Play Quake II - Voodoo.bat' does 'if exist VOODOO2HZ.BAT call VOODOO2HZ.BAT' before start /w.
4. Without the operator value, no fragment is written and 60 stays.
- Do not use FLEETRES -cmd output: it emits set "VAR=val", which COMMAND.COM misreads.
- The registry alternative (Voodoo2\Glide SSTV2_REFRESH_640x480, what the control panel's override writes) is a 3dfx-driver setting and needs the operator.
- Software launcher: nothing possible in the engine.
titles.fix_risk:
- An unproven rate means 'out of range' on an unattended CRT, on a box that needs a person to recover.
- Glide silently turns any value other than 75, 85 or 120 into 60.
- COMMAND.COM upper-cases env names (SSTV2_REFRESH_640X480). The MSVC CRT getenv in GLIDE2X.DLL and its registry fallback compare case-insensitively, but verify it.
- COMMAND.COM 'Out of environment space' would drop the set silently.
- mingw helpers on Win98 are suspect (memory note).
titles.verify_on_hw:
- For one run, set SSTV2_INITDEBUG_FILE=C:\V2INIT.TXT, which enables logging by itself (print.c).

titles.title: HexenII
titles.engine_and_build:
Raven Hexen II, a GLQuake derivative (confirmed):
- glh2.exe 530,944 B md5 c450ea8a (the same file as VOODOO\GLH2.EXE).
- h2.exe 674,816 B md5 7ad8abed (software).
- VOODOO\OPENGL32.DLL = the Quake II 3.20 MiniGL (md5 332ee07b).
- Glroot-3dfx-minigl\opengl32.dll (126,464 B, md5 914847f5) is parked and not on the load path.
- The '1.03' version string was not independently confirmed; not load-bearing.
titles.on_boxes:
.123 .124 .145 .195 .240 .243 (confirmed).
- NT boxes: Play, Host LAN and Join LAN all run glh2.exe on the system ICD.
- .124: the Voodoo shortcut CALLs Play Hexen II.bat; retrogl.log shows glh2 at 1024x768.
- .243: the Voodoo launcher runs the MiniGL over Glide 2.56; the Software launcher runs h2.exe on the Cirrus.
titles.resolution_per_box:
The launchers call FLEETRES -cap 1024 768, then glh2 -width %FR_W% -height %FR_H% (no -bpp).
- .123 and .240: 848x480, computed. The cap keeps 16:9, and both list 848x480@75.
- .145 and .195: 1024x768. They list no 16:9 mode 1024 wide or narrower, so the cap itself is used.
- .124: 1024x768 (retrogl.log).
- .243: 640x480x16 (Voodoo launcher); h2.exe defaults to 320x200.
- Unmeasured: whether glh2's 30-entry list (cmp ecx,0x1e at 0x4308e2, confirmed) holds 848x480 on the ATI boxes. Without it, glh2 stops with 'Specified video mode not available' and the Host listen server never opens.
- With no -bpp, the GLQuake-family search tries 15, 16, 32 in turn, so glh2 may run 16-bit.
titles.refresh_control:
None (confirmed).
- Strings: r_norefresh, timerefresh, vid_mode; switches -width/-height/-bpp, plus -current (same skip-the-CDS logic as GLQuake).
- glh2 VID_SetFullDIBMode: 0x42f565 dmFields 0x1c0000; 0x42f5a9 dmSize 0x9c; 0x42f59d push 4; 0x42f5b8 call CDSA.
- Voodoo path: MiniGL ref 0 plus SSTV2_*.
- .124: fxBestRefresh, then Glide's FX_GLIDE_REFRESH.
titles.set_today:
Nothing (confirmed).
- No GAMERES rule.
- The launchers pass -width/-height/-heapsize/-nocdaudio (plus -listen or +menu_multiplayer).
- The Voodoo launcher passes 640x480x16 and no SSTV2_*.
- .124's FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 applies.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
- .123, .145, .240: most likely 60 (unmeasured).
- .195: 60.
- .124: most likely 75. retrogl.log shows 'fxBestRefresh: 1024x768 max 85 Hz -> enum 7'; the registry override was measured by glidelab; 1024x768@75 is in vcr-kmd's table.
- .243 Voodoo: 60 (unmeasured).
- h2.exe: probably Win98's 75 (unmeasured).
titles.gap:
- -15 Hz on the XP LCD boxes.
- -10 Hz on .124.
- None on .195.
- .243 has no provable ceiling.
titles.fix:
Use the Quake1 mechanism with FR_HZW, the best rate at the post-cap FR_W x FR_H:
- Launch REFRESHKEEP.EXE hidden (hidden.vbs, not 'start /min') on glh2.exe in Play, Host and Join, gated on FR_UE1DEV != GlideDrv and FR_HZW > 60.
- .124: set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=%FR_HZW% in the launcher (env only; registry changes need explicit chat approval).
- .243: an SSTV2_REFRESH_640x480 fragment only from an operator-recorded ceiling (see Quake2Win9x).
- No source port is on the share (case-insensitive check).
- Settle 848x480 first, together with the resolution workflow.
titles.fix_risk:
- The same risks as Quake1.
- On the Host launcher, a re-apply that deactivates glh2 would restore the desktop and stall the listen server for every joiner. Test Host and Join on two boxes.
- If glh2 runs 16-bit, refreshkeep only forces a rate the driver lists at 16 bpp. Safe, but it may silently do nothing.
- Refreshing a mode glh2 refuses is moot.
titles.verify_on_hw:
- DISPLAYCFG get at the menu. This also shows the real resolution and bpp on .123/.240.
- Check the OSD.
- nqquery.py <host> 26900 HEXENII to confirm the host still serves after the re-apply.
- .124: retrogl.log and the vcrctl log.
- .243: SSTV2_INITDEBUG_FILE.
titles.verifier_notes:
Confirmed: all glh2 addresses; no refresh control; the 848x480/1024x768 computation (identical cap code in fleetres.c and gameres.h; all four LCD boxes' FLEETRES take the LCD branch); PER-TITLE-STATUS.md 'HexenII 1080p (measured .145)' is stale (the launchers have capped at 1024x768 since 2026-08-31).

Corrected: the launch method; the gate; .243 needs an operator ceiling.

Added: -current exists; no -bpp means 16-bit may be chosen.

Evidence: the survey's hexen2-glh2-cds.txt; .claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-review/strings-refresh-ci.txt.

titles.title: SiNGold
titles.engine_and_build:
Ritual SiN 1.11 (id Tech 2 derivative) plus Wages of SiN (2015\). Confirmed:
- sin.exe 667,648 B md5 8d320d7f.
- ref_gl.dll 278,528 B md5 050bdfd6; ref_soft.dll is the same md5 (a deliberate copy).
- ref_gl_amd.dll 283,648 B md5 4dd5b116.
- ref_soft_real.dll 262,144 B md5 d5320ca5 (the genuine software renderer).
- SiN's own 3dfxgl.dll (137,728 B md5 226edb25) calls grSstWinOpen with ref 0 at its single site (0x100036df). It is unused, since gl_driver is opengl32.
titles.on_boxes:
.123 .124 .145 .195 .240 (confirmed).
- Not on .243: the compat DB records 'not enough free disk (have 604 MB, needs 1040)'.
- GL via opengl32 on .123/.240/.195, and on .124 through retroicd (sin.exe at 1280x960 in retrogl.log).
- .145: every GL context kills sin.exe, so 'Play SiN - software renderer.bat' (ref_soft_real, DirectDraw) is the working shortcut.
titles.resolution_per_box:
GL: gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE% = 8 = 1280x960 on .123/.240/.195/.124. The mode is set at least twice: the first set precedes autoexec, then autoexec's gl_mode "6" followed by fleetres.cfg's "8" forces a vid_restart.

CORRECTED for .145 (software): 1024x768 (sw_mode 6), not 1280x960.
- The launcher's '+set sw_mode %FR_Q2MODE%' is an EARLY command.
- base\autoexec.cfg later runs 'set sw_mode "6"', and nothing re-asserts 8: fleetres.cfg carries only gl_mode and vid_fullscreen, and the late buffer carries only 'vid_ref soft_real'.
- This is the same two-buffer mechanism the launcher's own comment documents for vid_ref.
- The launcher's verified note also records 'mode 6: 1024 768 FS' on .145.
- PER-TITLE-STATUS.md's 'the software launcher gets sw_mode %FR_Q2MODE%' is true of the command line only.
titles.refresh_control:
None (confirmed).
- Case-insensitive strings: gl_mode, gl_bitdepth, gl_driver, gl_swapinterval, sw_mode, con_vidmode, r_norefresh, SST_GAMMA/SSTV2_GAMMA putenv. 'Setting frequency from' is a script-effect parameter.
- ref_gl: 0x12017c54 dmFields 0x1c0000; 0x12017cbe push 4; 0x12017cc1 call ebx (CDSA).
- ref_gl_amd: 0x12016954 and 0x120169be.
- No frequency in the retries either.
titles.set_today:
- fleetres.cfg (base and 2015) holds only gl_mode and vid_fullscreen, the same as the GAMERES idtech2 body.
- The software launcher passes only +set sw_mode, which autoexec then overrides to 6.
- FRHZ is unused.
- .124's FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 applies.
titles.best_per_box:
- .123: 1280x960@75
- .240: 1280x960@75
- .195: 1280x960@60
- .124: 1280x960@85
- .145: 1024x768@75 (software path; the number is unchanged by the resolution correction)
titles.expected_today_per_box:
- .123, .240: most likely 60 on every mode set.
- .145: most likely 60. ref_soft uses DirectDraw SetDisplayMode with no refresh; unmeasured.
- .195: 60.
- .124: most likely 75. The ICD asks for 85; Glide's registry override (measured via glidelab) applies; 1280x960@75 is in vcr-kmd's table. Unmeasured in game.
titles.gap:
- -15 Hz on .123 and .240.
- Probably -15 Hz on .145 (1024x768@75 available).
- -10 Hz on .124.
- None on .195.
titles.fix:
- Use the generic mechanism: a hidden REFRESHKEEP.EXE on sin.exe at %FR_HZ43% in 'Play SiN Gold.bat' and 'Play Wages of SiN.bat', gated on FR_UE1DEV != GlideDrv and FR_HZ43 > 60.
- For the .145 software launcher, the rate must be the one at 1024x768, not FR_HZ43 (both are 75 there today). Add it only after measuring refreshkeep under DirectDraw exclusive mode.
- .124: set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=%FR_HZ43% in the launchers.
- There is no per-title route: no engine source, and no port on the share.
titles.fix_risk:
- The same risks as Quake1.
- SiN sets the mode several times during a start that takes more than 60 s, so refreshkeep re-applies after each. It needs a generous first-apply delay and time limit.
- On .145, an external CDS under a DirectDraw exclusive-mode surface risks surface loss or a failed call; unmeasured.
- Fixing the resolution (autoexec's sw_mode 6) belongs to the resolution workflow. Do not change it here.
titles.verify_on_hw:
- DISPLAYCFG get only after at least 100 s at the menu; earlier readings catch intermediate modes.
- +set logfile 2 records the mode lines ('mode 6: 1024 768 FS' expected on .145).
- Check the OSD.
- .124: retrogl.log and the vcrctl log.
titles.verifier_notes:
Confirmed: md5s, strings and all CDS addresses (ref_gl and ref_gl_amd); no refresh control; on_boxes (compat DB reason); best rates.

Refuted: the .145 software resolution (1024x768 via autoexec's sw_mode 6, not 1280x960). This is inferred from config order plus the launcher's own recorded observation, and is unmeasured since FLEETRES was added.

Added: the multiple GL mode sets per start; the launch method and gate.

Evidence: Games-Library\SiNGold\base\autoexec.cfg (set sw_mode "6" before exec fleetres.cfg); 'Play SiN - software renderer.bat' comments; .claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-review/strings-refresh-ci.txt.

titles.title: SoldierOfFortune
titles.engine_and_build:
Raven Soldier of Fortune, an id Tech 2 derivative:
- SoF.exe 2,052,096 B md5 2f4db377.
- ref_gl.dll 225,280 B md5 e0454d95.
- Only the menus run: every map stops at 'ERROR: Please insert the SOF CD and try again.' (.124's user\sof.log).
- The '1.03 x86F' version was not independently confirmed; not load-bearing.
titles.on_boxes:
.123 .124 .145 .195 .240 (confirmed).
- Not on .243: the compat DB records 'no 3D acceleration at all and this title has no software renderer'.
- ref_gl uses opengl32 (the system ICD); on .124 that is retroicd, and sof.log shows GL_RENDERER 'Mesa Glide v0.62 Voodoo5 6000 [voodoo-cleanroom 0.1.76]'.
- The GL path on .145 is untested.
titles.resolution_per_box:
gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE% = 8 = 1280x960 on all five.
- On .124: sof.log '...setting mode 8: 1280 960 FS ...calling CDS: ok', and base\fleetres.cfg set gl_mode "8".
- SoF sets the mode ONCE per run. retrogl.log shows exactly one GL context per SoF.exe pid (628, 1724, 384, 900, 1660, 992): autoexec does not change gl_mode, and SoF's vid_fullscreen default is "1" (string at 0x201a9840), so nothing triggers a vid_restart.
titles.refresh_control:
YES: ref_gl.dll's own gl_displayrefresh. Confirmed:
- Registration: Cvar_Get('gl_displayrefresh','0',CVAR_ARCHIVE) (push 1, push '0', push name at 0x30010460/0x30010465), pointer stored at 0x3008cadc.
- The ONLY read is at 0x3001b81f in GLimp_SetMode; there is no ->modified check anywhere, so a changed value takes effect only at the next mode set.
- When the value is non-zero: dmDisplayFrequency=(int)value (0x3001b85d) and dmFields=0x580000 (0x3001b864), then CDS(&dm, CDS_FULLSCREEN) at 0x3001b8ff.
- If that fails, the '...calling CDS assuming dual monitors' retry (0x3001b9ac) uses 0x180000 or 0x1c0000 with no frequency.
- The frequency is never logged.
- A case-insensitive grep of the repo and the library text files finds no gl_displayrefresh; only r_displayRefresh in the id Tech 3 launchers.
titles.set_today:
Not set by anything we ship (confirmed).
- base\fleetres.cfg (launcher and GAMERES idtech2 body) holds only gl_mode and vid_fullscreen; base\autoexec.cfg does not set it.
- Correction: SoF archives it. .124's user\config.cfg (written at clean exit; sof.log 'Wrote configuration to ./user/config.cfg.') contains set gl_displayrefresh "0".
- .145 has no user\config.cfg, so no clean exit has happened there.
- .124's FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 applies.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
- .123, .145, .240: most likely 60 (cvar 0, no frequency; unmeasured).
- .195: 60.
- .124: most likely 75. The ICD asks for 85 (retrogl ref enum 7); Glide's registry 75 applies (mechanism measured via glidelab).
titles.gap:
- -15 Hz on the XP LCD boxes.
- -10 Hz on .124.
- None on .195.
- The gain is visible in the menus only while the disc check blocks maps.
titles.fix:
REFUTED: the survey's fix would not take effect. Both its forms, a GAMERES-only base\fleethz.cfg exec'd from autoexec.cfg or a line in the shared base\fleetres.cfg, deliver the value at autoexec time. That is AFTER the run's only mode set:
- .124's user\sof.log shows 'Loading ref_gl.dll', '...setting mode 8: 1280 960 FS' and '...calling CDS: ok' before 'execing autoexec.cfg' and 'execing fleetres.cfg'.
- SoF.exe CL_Init calls VID_Init (0x2006d110, which tail-jumps to VID_CheckChanges and loads ref_%s.dll) at 0x2000dda0, before FS_ExecAutoexec at 0x2000ddf3.
- ref_gl never re-reads the cvar, and there is no vid_restart.
- At best it would be archived on a clean exit and apply one launch late. A killed game never archives it.

Correct fix: pass the value on the command line in 'Play Soldier of Fortune.bat':
  start "" SoF.exe +set gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE% +set gl_displayrefresh %FR_HZ43%
- SoF's Qcommon_Init runs Cbuf_AddEarlyCommands ('+set' -> 'set %s %s', 0x20019b50) before FS/config and again after 'exec config.cfg' (0x20020c97), both before VID_Init. That is why the launcher already passes gl_mode there. The +set also overrides the archived value.
- FR_HZ43 must come from FLEETRES: gr_best_hz at FR_W43xFR_H43 with the EDID vmax cap, 0 without EDID. 0 means no frequency, which is today's behaviour. Default it to 0 in FLEETRES.BAT.
- No cfg file is touched, so there is no FLEETRES/GAMERES shared-file fight and nothing for GAMERES to mirror.
- Do NOT add it to the idtech2 body: that body is shared by Quake2Complete (4 files), SiNGold (2) and SoF (1), and a line their launchers do not echo trips test_a_shared_cfg_is_written_identically_by_both_writers (the fight). It would also be too late.
- On .124 (FR_UE1DEV=GlideDrv), pass the same number as FX_GLIDE_REFRESH, or omit it: Glide re-sets the mode and decides the final rate.
titles.fix_risk:
Low.
- The rate is EDID-capped and driver-listed. If the driver refuses, SoF's own retry sets the mode without a frequency, at the cost of one extra mode switch.
- CVAR_ARCHIVE means the value persists in user\config.cfg. The command line re-asserts it every launch; only direct SoF.exe starts (e.g. .124's LANCHECK.BAT) use the archived value, on the same monitor.
- On .124, a mismatched rate between SoF's CDS and Glide's own mode set costs an extra CRT resync.
- The payoff is in the menus only until the WON disc check is solved.
titles.verify_on_hw:
- Launch through the desktop shortcut with +set logfile 2.
- user\sof.log must show '...calling CDS: ok', not '...calling CDS assuming dual monitors' (which would mean the frequency was refused). The log never prints the rate.
- Then DISPLAYCFG get at the menu, the OSD, and 'gl_displayrefresh' at the console.
- .124: retrogl.log and the vcrctl log.
titles.verifier_notes:
Confirmed: gl_displayrefresh exists, with every quoted address (dmSize 0x94, freq at devmode+0x78, dmFields 0x580000, the dual-monitor retry with no frequency); it is absent from the repo and library; the CLAUDE.md/gameres.h claim 'the Quake II lineage carries no refresh cvar' is wrong for SoF's ref_gl.

Refuted: the proposed delivery (timing), and the survey's 'no archived value exists' as a fleet-wide statement (.124 archives "0").

Evidence (read-only DOWNLOAD 01:12 EDT): .claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-review/boxes/124-soflog.json.C__Games__SoldierOfFortune__user__sof.log and ...__config.cfg; sof-exe-startup-order.txt; sof-ref_gl-displayrefresh.txt; the survey's retrogl.log (one context per SoF pid).
